title: Holistic Shepherding: Stable Failover Coalescer and Backpressure Harmonization (hotfix)
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: a production incident (INT-5678) showed repeated region failover flapping when transient health probes overlapped with aggressive tenant-level shedding; this caused cascading KV cache drains and a spike in tail latency. Goal: implement a lightweight failover coalescer that groups committed failover decisions within a short soft-holdoff window, harmonize it with the per-tenant rate limiter to smooth backpressure bursts, and add safer KV-drain fencing so requests are not lost during rapid handoffs. This PR introduces a failover coalescer component in the controlplane, a coalescer-aware circuit state (sticky-with-decay), a coalesced rate-limiter hook to delay aggressive shedding when a coalesced event is in flight, and telemetry/alerts to detect coalescer-induced stalls. Changes are designed as a targeted hotfix (no public API changes) with opt-in rollout via a feature flag (feature.failover_coalescer=true) to allow staged enablement. Checklist: 1) implement coalescer state machine and holdoff timer; 2) wire into regional failover orchestration; 3) add backpressure harmonizer in rate-limiter path; 4) extend KV drain protocol with sequence fencing and graceful retry markers; 5) add unit + integration tests covering coalescer edge cases; 6) add observability events and a Grafana dashboard fragment; 7) add rollback plan and backport to release/2026-01 if needed. Testing summary: local unit tests + integration suite on canary infra covering failover flapping, simulated network partitions, and tenant surge scenarios; latency and throughput validated against typical PLG workload traces; manual soak for 48h on canary region. Rollout plan: enable on 1 canary region for 2 hours, monitor failover.coalescer.activated, coalescer.coalesced_events, and per-tenant tail latency; if stable, ramp to additional regions across 6 hours. Rollback: flip feature flag off and revert to prior controlplane snapshot; KV drain fencing is backward-compatible and will not block prior nodes. Mitigation during rollout: keep conservative default holdoff (500ms) and micro-backoff decay to avoid long stalls. Related: ENG-1945 summarizes incident postmortem, SUP-1023 is the customer support ticket.
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial coalescer state machine + tests; harmonizer hook and KV-fence extension; telemetry and docs + rollout flags
review_comments: Rohit: Can you explain why 500ms was chosen as the default holdoff? We should make it configurable per-region; response: Default chosen after running traces from canary workload; added region_override in flags.go and clarified in rollout docs.
Elena: KV drain fence looks correct but add a unit test for fence replay; response: added tests/drain_fence_replay and integration scenario to simulate clients retrying with markers.
Samir: Concern about coalescer state persistence across controlplane restarts; response: manager now persists active coalescer tombstones to the lightweight raft log and recovers on leader election.
merge_summary: Squashed and merged after 2 approvals. CI green after adding fence replay test and small linter fixes. Deployed to canary region within 30 minutes of merge.
release_notes: Hotfix: introduce failover coalescer and backpressure harmonizer to reduce regional failover flapping and tail latency spikes. Opt-in via feature.failover_coalescer; default conservative settings applied. Backport candidate for release/2026-01.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature.failover_coalescer=false by default; to roll out, follow docs/rollout/feature-flags.md. Monitor metrics: failover.coalescer.coalesced_events (should increase briefly), failover.coalescer.rejected_events, telemetry.kv.drain_fence_replays, tenant.tail_latency_p95. If coalescer causes unexpected stalls, set feature.failover_coalescer=false and scale out failover orchestration replicas.
